fields.mechanism: Load distribution through composite materials with varying elastic moduli
fields.intervention: Develop a multi-layered tibial tray with gradient elasticity, transitioning from stiff metallic components to compliant polymer materials at the bone interface
fields.expected_effect: Reduced stress shielding and improved load transfer to bone, minimizing bone resorption and implant loosening
fields.falsification_test: Finite element analysis comparing stress distribution and micromotion between conventional and gradient elasticity tibial trays under physiological loading conditions
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Allograft size and quality were assessed preoperatively. A tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) was performed prior to revision TKA. After implantation of the definitive prosthesis, the TTO was fixed to the tibia using screws."

fields.mechanism: Preservation of native patellar retinacula and prepatellar fascia to optimize graft coverage
fields.intervention: Design a prosthesis with anatomically shaped retention elements that preserve surrounding soft tissue structures
fields.expected_effect: Maintained natural biomechanical environment reducing forces that contribute to implant loosening
fields.falsification_test: Biomechanical testing comparing stress distribution at bone-implant interface with and without anatomical retention elements
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Native patellar retinacula and prepatellar fascia were preserved to optimize graft coverage."

fields.mechanism: Tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) with secure fixation to maintain extensor mechanism alignment and stability
fields.intervention: Incorporate a tibial tubercle osteotomy fixation system with adjustable positioning screws to secure the tibial tubercle to the tibia after implantation
fields.expected_effect: Prevent loosening of implant not related to bone-ingrowth by maintaining proper alignment and load distribution through the extensor mechanism
fields.falsification_test: In vitro mechanical testing comparing implant stability with and without the TTO fixation system under cyclic loading simulating knee flexion/extension
fields.mechanism_source_span: A tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) was performed prior to revision TKA. After implantation of the definitive prosthesis, the TTO was fixed to the tibia using screws.

fields.mechanism: Multi-physics hybrid mechanism combining mechanical fixation and bioactive surface treatment
fields.intervention: Design a knee prosthesis with a porous titanium coating combined with a hydrogel-based drug delivery system that promotes bone ingrowth while reducing micromotion at the interface
fields.expected_effect: Enhanced osseointegration through controlled release of osteogenic factors while maintaining mechanical stability through the porous structure
fields.falsification_test: In vivo animal study comparing micromotion at the bone-implant interface using motion capture technology and micro-CT analysis of bone ingrowth between conventional and hybrid prostheses
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Allograft size and quality were assessed preoperatively. A tibial tubercle osteotomy (TTO) was performed prior to revision TKA. After implantation of the definitive prosthesis, the TTO was fixed to the tibia using screws."

fields.mechanism: Extensor mechanism reconstruction using allograft with precise fixation and Pulvertaft weave technique
fields.intervention: Incorporate an integrated extensor mechanism allograft system with tibial tubercle osteotomy fixation and quadriceps tendon attachment using Pulvertaft weave technique
fields.expected_effect: Improved load distribution and reduced stress at the bone-implant interface, preventing loosening not related to bone ingrowth
fields.falsification_test: Compare implant loosening rates between conventional knee prostheses and those with integrated extensor mechanism allograft system under simulated physiological loading conditions over 5 years
fields.mechanism_source_span: Performing combined extensor mechanism allograft reconstruction and revision TKA as a single-stage procedure requires precise surgical technique. The quadriceps tendon was sutured to the allograft using the Pulvertaft weave technique with the knee in full extension.
